scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node init && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.start:backend: node init && cd backend && npm start
scripts.start:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run dev
